verdict.rationale: IP India's e-services portal offers e-filing, public search and single-application status tracking, so bulk operations are a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents batch filing, bulk status lookup, bulk downloads or any other multi-item operation. The navigation items cited (e-Filing, Track Status, Cause List) describe per-item workflows only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
